name: Home shows services, seasonal help, reviews, and contact details
description: Confirms the homepage shows the service categories, current seasonal message, reviews, key contact information, and reveal motion as content enters view.
steps: Review the service categories and fall cleanup message
Scroll down through the service cards and reviews
Use the review controls to show another customer review
expected: The home page shows both service categories and fall cleanup, content fades and rises into view as the visitor scrolls, the review changes when tapped, and one phone number and the supplied business hours are displayed.

name: Services page shows package pricing and yard estimates
description: Confirms service pricing details remain available on the Services page after they are removed from Home.
steps: Review the detailing packages and size adjustments
Review yard service rates, yard sizes, and add-ons
expected: Detailing packages show $60, $60, and $120, and yard rates are labeled as estimates pending a final quote.

name: Gallery organizes before-and-after work
description: Confirms project photos can be filtered and compared in the Gallery.
expected: The gallery filters to matching work and the selected before-and-after slider responds.

name: Instant quote updates from selected service options
description: Confirms the quote calculator combines package, vehicle size, and add-on prices before showing request fields.
steps: Open Contact from a Get a quote link
expected: The total estimate updates to $80 and the preferred date, time, and contact fields appear.

name: Mobile navigation, FAQ, contact form, and legal pages
description: Checks key site routes and expandable content on a phone-sized screen.
steps: Open the home page on mobile
Open the menu and choose Service areas
Open FAQ and expand What services do you offer?
Open Contact and submit the empty service request form
Open the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service
expected: The linked pages open correctly, the FAQ answer expands, the empty service request shows a validation message, and the mobile layout has no horizontal overflow.
